content:
support-ops: Acme is seeing SSE streams drop after long idle periods. Partial event(s) arrive, then TCP FIN/RST from the edge and client reconnect only gets subsequent events (missing the tail). Happens behind Cloudflare + ALB -> private app. Repro steps attached, customer is blocked.
maria: can you paste the minimal repro and any request/response headers? ticket id?
customer-jira: ticket ACME-3142. Repro (minimal):
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  https://api.acme.example/v1/stream?prompt=hello
```
Observed output:
```
event: data
data: {"text":"Hello wor"

# connection closes, client reconnects, next chunk contains "ld" only on new session
```
chris: thanks. classic proxy idle/aggregation behavior. likely flow: edge (Cloudflare) or ALB buffers/chunks then hits idle timeout -> half-close -> RST/FIN. App never gets chance to flush final chunk to client before upstream closes.
ben: ALB default idle timeout 60s, Cloudflare will buffer and attempt to revalidate. If origin sends small final chunk and immediately closes, some proxies drop trailing bytes. Also gzip/chunked interplay can cause truncation.
ben: quick check: can you run tcpdump on the origin host while reproducing? look for FIN/RST from 3rd party IP, and whether app sent the last chunk before FIN. e.g.
```
sudo tcpdump -n -i eth0 host <cloudflare-ip> and port 443 -w /tmp/sse.pcap
# look for "FIN" flags and lengths
```
maria: customer attached pcap excerpt: shows origin TCP segment with 34 bytes then immediately a FIN, then cloudflare sends an ACK and RST. looks like origin closed prior to proxy completing TLS flush.
chris: couple of practical mitigations to try (low-risk, do asap):
- ensure SSE responses use `Content-Type: text/event-stream` and `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` (do NOT send Content-Length)
- disable response compression for streaming routes: `Cache-Control: no-transform` or explicitly disable gzip for that endpoint
- emit a heartbeat comment every 15s: `: keepalive\n\n` so proxies see traffic and don't idle-close
- set `Connection: keep-alive` and `tcp_nodelay` on socket writes
- on nginx/proxies: `proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Connection ""; proxy_buffering off; chunked_transfer_encoding on; proxy_cache off; sendfile off; tcp_nodelay on;`

chris: ALB/ELB tips: set idle timeout > heartbeat (e.g., 120s). For NLB use TCP target group to avoid HTTP-level buffering. For ALB make sure target groups use keepalive enabled.
ben: Cloudflare: if proxied (orange-cloud), Cloudflare sometimes aggregates & replays origin after origin close. For SSE we recommend bypassing buffering via page rules or use `cache-control: no-transform` and send frequent heartbeats. If using Workers, ensure the worker streams the body rather than buffer.
maria: customer tried setting heartbeat to 10s -> improvement but still rare truncations under high upstream load.
chris: more deterministic repro ideas for engineering: 1) reproduce with slow writes from origin (sleep 100ms between chunks) 2) run with gzip forced on -> you'll likely hit truncation quickly 3) run behind haproxy in front of ALB to emulate extra buffering
ben: we saw a pattern where when a deployed runtime did an immediate socket close on EOF the proxy responded with FIN before flushing TLS records. Recommend keeping socket open for a short grace period after final write (100-300ms) to allow proxies to finish TLS handshake/flush.
maria: action items:
- support: share pcap (done) and full request headers (customer will redact)
- eng-runtime (chris): reproduce locally with haproxy + cloudflare emulator, try keepalive-delay fix
- infra (ben): verify ALB idle timeout and target-group keepalive settings for Acme's dedicated cluster
- support: propose temporary workaround to customer: heartbeat + disable gzip + increase ALB idle timeout
infra-bot: Deployment info: acme-prod cluster behind ALB (app-targets) in us-west-2, ALB idle_timeout currently 60s per terraform: `aws_lb.idle_timeout = 60`
chris: i'll try a small runtime patch to hold socket open 200ms after final chunk and add opt-in `x-sse-keepalive-ms` header for testing. if that reduces repro, consider default in next runtime patch.
maria: customer accepted workaround steps and wants ETA for patch. can eng mark priority P1 for acme? they are hitting paid SLA.
chris: marking P1 and will attempt repro today, will report back with test artifacts.
maria: thanks team :heart: please post any packet captures and headers here when available.
